provider_runner: Reuse historical NativeSDKRunner/run-nz + capture/project; no paid launcher included in this suite

permissions.style: workspace-scoped file tools and explicit local argv allowlist plus production built-in guards

bash_allowed_argv_patterns: python|python3 -m app.cli NAME VALUE [--correlation-id ID] [--format text|json]
constraints: A shell permission denial is logged separately from command failure
permissions.future_wiring: Translate patterns to argv checks and validate in the separately authorized run preflight; never bypass production guards

network: Existing offline_exec inherited AF_INET/AF_INET6 denial, no Provider forwarding this phase

capture.tool_result: canonical metadata including timeout, exit, cancellation, dispatch/command failure
capture.usage: Provider raw fields; separate main/aux IDs; cost unknown unless provider billing exposed

future_budget: Freeze model/caps/settings per future authorization before any run; no paid budget assigned or consumed now
stop: Freeze each sample. At deterministic Core divergence stop remaining tasks if no causal value; design offline RED separately. Never patch mid-run.
